title: (Pwn2Own) Softing Secure Integration Server wbemcomn Uncontrolled Search Path Element Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Softing Secure Integration Server. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute high-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of project files. The service loads a DLL file from an unsecured location. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code in the context of SYSTEM.
